description: This file implements shared channel invitation handling, including creating, restoring, and syncing shared channels and direct/group channels in a Mattermost environment. It manages remote cluster communication for channel sharing.

classes.name: channelInviteMsg
classes.description: Represents an invitation message for sharing a channel with a remote cluster, including channel details and participants.

methods.name: DirectParticipantsMap
methods.description: Returns a map of participant IDs to User objects for quick lookup.

methods.name: SendChannelInvite
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a channel invite to a remote cluster, handling online/offline states and updating shared channel records.

methods.name: onReceiveChannelInvite
methods.description: Handles incoming channel invite messages from remote clusters, creating or restoring channels and updating shared channel records.

methods.name: combineErrors
methods.description: Combines an error and a string message into a single error string.

methods.name: handleChannelCreation
methods.description: Creates a new local channel to represent a remote channel based on invite data, for direct, group, or team channels.

methods.name: getOrCreateUser
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID or creates it if it doesn't exist, using invite data and remote cluster info.

methods.name: createDirectChannel
methods.description: Creates or fetches a direct message channel between two users based on invite data.

methods.name: createGroupChannel
methods.description: Creates or fetches a group message channel based on invite data, ensuring participant constraints.
